# Shirin Abplanalp — Real Estate With Shirin
# Licensed REALTOR®, SRES® at eXp Realty serving Northern Idaho
# Idaho Real Estate License #1371861

## About
Shirin Abplanalp is a licensed REALTOR® and Seniors Real Estate Specialist (SRES®) at eXp Realty serving buyers, sellers, and relocating families across Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, and Sandpoint, Idaho. She relocated to Northern Idaho herself from Bend, Oregon, giving her firsthand knowledge of the move and the lifestyle.
